english.title: Use vehicle on Manchester Airport apron in breach of regulations regarding colour / identification / lights etc
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), other than in an emergency, (A)_[used a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[caused or permitted a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to be used]_

on the apron of Manchester Airport, a part of the airport to which the road traffic enactments did not apply, when the

(C)_[roof of the vehicle was not coloured yellow]_
(D)_[vehicle did not display valid means of identification on both the nearside and offside in that **(..SPECIFY ITEM NOT DISPLAYED..)]_
(E)_[front and rear lights of the vehicle were not switched on during the hours of darkness]_
(F)_[front and rear lights of the vehicle were not switched on in poor visibility]_
(G)_[front and rear lights of the vehicle were not switched on in poor visibility during the hours of darkness]_
(H)_[(**..SPECIFY COMBINATION OF THE ABOVE..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws2.2 and 5.8 ofthe Manchester Airport Byelaws 2024.
